purpose: Characterize temporal self-convergence and state-change cost signals for the conservative C1R Ross update before selecting any production timestep-acceptance threshold.

source_basis.reason: Ross source lineage uses central time weighting in unsaturated conditions; Gate F1 does not compare or retune sigma after execution.
source_basis.retry_structure: a rejected trial may be recomputed at smaller dt from the same physical base state; F1 characterizes fixed-step trajectories only and does not yet qualify the retry controller

precommitted_trajectory_matrix.external_forcing_policy: q_top, q_bottom, source and sink are frozen from the initial state and remain constant over the horizon for every resolution of a scenario

independent_reference_policy.reference: repeat the same conservative Ross update over the same horizon with independently re-evaluated C1R fluxes and derivatives at every much smaller accepted substep
independent_reference_policy.fine_reference: repeat again at half the reference dt
independent_reference_policy.important_limit: This is a temporal self-convergence oracle for RossFast, not a FullRichards physics oracle. FullRichards comparison remains Gate M.

aligned_time_metrics: maximum relative head error using max(1 cm, abs(reference head)) denominator
relative bottom-head error using max(1 cm, abs(reference bottom head)) denominator
maximum accepted-step Delta theta divided by theta_s-theta_r
reference_convergence_metrics: same state/head metrics for reference dt against fine-reference dt at aligned reference times
explicit_nonclaims: F1 does not itself qualify a production timestep policy.
F1 does not qualify FullRichards accuracy.
F1 does not qualify saturation, heterogeneity, groundwater or other bottom-boundary modes.
F1 does not change the Gate-D mass ledger or C1R table/derivative representation.
